trap.label: decide + to
trap.wrong: He decided open a school and we plan teach 500.
trap.right: He decided to open a school, and we plan to teach 500.
trap.why: Em português “decidiu abrir” e “planejamos ensinar” usam infinitivo direto. Em inglês é igual, mas o brasileiro esquece o to, ou usa -ing ou for.

fix.right: He decided to open a school.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “Ele decidiu” + open: “He decided ... a school.”
rewrite.answer: He decided to open a school.
